meta.title: Paired expansion and reverse reconstruction
meta.summary: Four of six Round19 loop gates are accepted: boundary-consistent clipped clusters, a direct product representation, the complete 48-channel two-cube projector with exact cross Gram, and a finite two-cube continuous signed-box spectral certificate. C1 is running under its own static-integral contract. Parent dense/homogeneous stability, finite-restriction convergence, continuum construction and physical Fibonacci significance remain open.

geometry_hypothesis.title: Double Fibonacci-style golden-spiral work discipline
geometry_hypothesis.claim: The two opposing Fibonacci-style golden/log spirals are an organization-only formula for paired expansion nodes: the forward derivation expands a candidate construction, while the reverse reconstruction asks which premises the target statement would require.
geometry_hypothesis.limit: The SVG uses an approximate logarithmic/golden spiral formula, not exact Fibonacci arcs. No physical test of the geometry has been performed in Round19; its physical role remains an untested hypothesis. Each scientific loop must pass by graph, Haar, min-max, source-bound, and independent comparison checks.

unit_contract.record: Accepted A and B gates keep E★ positive. No numeric physical energy value, Hamiltonian time bridge, lattice-spacing limit or continuum mass scale is selected.

unit_contract.meaning: dimensionless electric coefficients relative to the same positive reference energy
unit_contract.record: Goal A records α_min/E★ = 1 for its common-scale local/product contract. Goal B records α/E★ = 2 for the finite two-cube spectral checkpoint.

unit_contract.meaning: dimensionless magnetic-face coefficients relative to α, separate from the E★ anchor
unit_contract.record: A1 bounds |λ_left|/α and |λ_right|/α by 1/2 and |μ_bridge|/α by 1/8. B2 records the signed box radius r = |λ_f|/α, including accepted finite two-cube bounds over the certified range.

unit_contract.meaning: static Euclidean coefficient for C-side integrals, kept outside the Hamiltonian energy-scale register
unit_contract.record: C1 is running under a static-integral contract. κ is not a regulator, physical time matching variable or Hamiltonian energy scale in the accepted A/B evidence.

review.summary: A1, A2, B1 and B2 are accepted within their declared finite/product scopes. B2 accepts a finite two-cube continuous signed-box certificate, not a dense limit, continuum theorem, Clay mass-gap result, or static κ physical match. C1 is running under a separate static-integral contract.
limits: The double-spiral geometry is a hypothesis and work organizer, not physical evidence.
A2 is a direct product-representation theorem, not finite clipped-restriction convergence or homogeneous dense stability.
B1 and B2 are finite two-cube spectral results; they do not prove the dense limiting spectral passage or continuum Yang-Mills.
Static κ is a coefficient for later Euclidean integrals, not a regulator, Hamiltonian time match, or physical energy scale.
No current Round19 file proves a continuum Yang-Mills construction, finite-restriction convergence to the A2 representation, or Clay mass gap.
